description:
About the Position

The Macquarie project develops graph-level mining methods for complex data environments. Research addresses challenges such as multiple data sources, low-quality data and interactions between graphs, aiming to produce both theoretical methods and empirical results. Macquarie University invites applications for a PhD position in this area: Graph-Level Mining for Complex Data Environments, Macquarie. Disciplinary scope: Machine Learning, Data Science. Location: Sydney, Australia. According to the listing, funding covers the full cost of participation; financial support is listed as AUD 40,900/year, indexed. Interested candidates should note the deadline: 15 December 2026.

Research Areas

  • Graph mining
  • Machine learning
  • Data science

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.mq.edu.au/research/phd-and-research-degrees/how-to-apply/scholarship-opportunities/scholarship-search/graph-level-mining-for-complex-data-environments-phd

Source: mq.edu.au - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 December 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Review the Macquarie project and confirm eligibility for its international scholarship route.
  2. Send the initial expression of interest to jia.wu@mq.edu.au, following the project’s document instructions.
  3. Complete the scholarship and admission stages requested by the host before 15 December 2026.

About Macquarie University

Macquarie offers doctoral research through its schools and research groups in Sydney. Its project scholarships support particular research topics, with applicants assessed for academic preparation, research fit and admission eligibility.
